test_cases.description: Verify that add_task correctly creates and returns a Task object when provided valid input data.
test_cases.name: add_task_with_valid_input

test_setup.given: A valid task title and description, no existing tasks, ID counter starts at 1.
test_setup.then: A Task object is created with ID=1, appended to the in-memory list, saved to JSON file, and returned.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title='Buy groceries', description='Milk, Bread, Eggs'.

test_cases.description: Verify that IDs are incremented correctly and tasks are persisted when adding multiple tasks.
test_cases.name: add_task_multiple_tasks

test_setup.given: Two tasks already exist with IDs 1 and 2; ID counter is at 3.
test_setup.then: A Task object is created with ID=3, appended to the list, saved to JSON, and returned.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title='Read book', description='Finish reading chapter 5'.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles missing task title (required field) appropriately.
test_cases.name: add_task_missing_title

test_setup.given: No task title provided in input.
test_setup.then: An error is raised or returned indicating title is required, no task is appended or persisted.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title=null, description='Some description'.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles missing description (optional field) appropriately.
test_cases.name: add_task_missing_description

test_setup.given: Task description is missing; only title provided.
test_setup.then: A Task object is created with the provided title, description is set to null or default, ID assigned, appended, persisted, and returned.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title='Finish homework', description=null.

test_cases.description: Verify that tasks with empty string titles are not accepted.
test_cases.name: add_task_empty_title

test_setup.given: Task title is an empty string.
test_setup.then: An error is raised or returned indicating title cannot be empty, no task is appended or persisted.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title='', description='Some description'.

test_cases.description: Verify that add_task can handle very large title and description values.
test_cases.name: add_task_large_title_and_description

test_setup.given: Title and description are very large strings (e.g., 10,000 characters each).
test_setup.then: A Task is created with large fields, appended, persisted, and returned (if allowed by system).
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title='T.repeat(10000)', description='D.repeat(10000)'.

test_cases.description: Verify that add_task can handle special characters in title and description.
test_cases.name: add_task_with_special_characters

test_setup.given: Title and description contain special characters (e.g., emoji, unicode, symbols).
test_setup.then: A Task is created with special characters, appended, persisted, and returned.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title='Test 🚀', description='Description with 💡 and symbols #!@'.

test_cases.description: Verify that add_task handles JSON file save failure gracefully.
test_cases.name: add_task_json_save_failure

test_setup.given: The JSON file is not writable (e.g., disk full or permissions issue).
test_setup.then: An error is raised or returned indicating persistence failure; task may not be appended or is rolled back; error is logged.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with valid title and description.

test_cases.description: Verify that add_task handles ID counter being corrupted (e.g., non-integer value).
test_cases.name: add_task_id_counter_corruption

test_setup.given: ID counter is set to a non-integer value (e.g., string or null).
test_setup.then: An error is raised or returned indicating ID assignment failure; task is not appended or persisted.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with valid title and description.

test_cases.description: Verify behavior when a task with a duplicate title is added.
test_cases.name: add_task_duplicate_title

test_setup.given: A task with title 'Buy groceries' already exists.
test_setup.then: A new Task is created with a new ID and duplicate title, appended, persisted, and returned (if duplicates are allowed).
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title='Buy groceries', description='New description'.

test_cases.description: Verify that add_task works with only required fields provided.
test_cases.name: add_task_with_minimal_fields

test_setup.given: Only title provided; description and other fields are omitted.
test_setup.then: Task is created with minimal fields, ID assigned, appended, persisted, and returned.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with title='Short Task'.

test_cases.description: Verify that task creation is logged successfully after task is created.

test_setup.given: Logging system is operational.

test_cases.description: Verify that task creation proceeds even if logging fails.
test_cases.name: add_task_logging_failure

test_setup.given: Logging system fails (e.g., logger throws exception).
test_setup.then: A Task is created, appended, persisted; logging failure is handled gracefully, does not prevent task creation.
test_setup.when: add_task is called with valid title and description.

test_cases.description: Verify that add_task rejects invalid input types.
